park_at_shop.gml: var r = global.run; map_generate(); var si = -1; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) if (r.map.nodes[i].kind == "shop") { si = i; break; } if (si < 0) return -1; r.node = si; global.shopnode = si; global.run.scrap = 9999; return si;

stock_rolled.gml: var n = map_node(global.shopnode); return is_array(n.stock) ? array_length(n.stock) : -1;

garage_opened_as_shop.gml: var c = global.garage_ctx; return (c.shop == true && array_length(c.stock) > 0);

node_and_garage_share_shelves.gml: var n = map_node(global.shopnode); var before = array_length(n.stock); array_delete(global.garage_ctx.stock, 0, 1); return (array_length(n.stock) == before - 1);

snapshot_ids.gml: var n = map_node(global.shopnode); global.shelf = []; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(n.stock); i++) array_push(global.shelf, n.stock[i]); return array_length(global.shelf);

shelves_unchanged_on_return.gml: var c = global.garage_ctx.stock; if (array_length(c) != array_length(global.shelf)) return false; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(c); i++) if (c[i] != global.shelf[i]) return false; return true;

sell_out.gml: var n = map_node(global.shopnode); while (array_length(n.stock) > 0) array_delete(n.stock, 0, 1); return array_length(n.stock);

fight_is_one_shot.gml: var r = global.run; var fi = -1; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) if (r.map.nodes[i].kind == "fight") { fi = i; break; } if (fi < 0) return -1; r.map.nodes[fi].resolved = true; r.node = fi; with (obj_map) map_resolve_arrival(); global.pending_room = -1; var last = r.log[array_length(r.log) - 1]; return (string_pos("tyre marks", last) > 0);

event_is_one_shot.gml: var r = global.run; var ei = -1; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(r.map.nodes); i++) if (r.map.nodes[i].kind == "event") { ei = i; break; } if (ei < 0) return -1; r.map.nodes[ei].resolved = true; r.node = ei; with (obj_map) map_resolve_arrival(); global.pending_room = -1; var last = r.log[array_length(r.log) - 1]; return (string_pos("tyre marks", last) > 0);

every_sector_shop_rolls_five.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 40; g++) { global.run.sector = 1 + (g mod 3); var s = shop_stock(); if (array_length(s) != 5) return false; } return true;

a played-out waypoint stays played out
